# Task: Finish Dependabot frontend green (#6607 + #6611) — Cursor takeover

AGY timed out once and was cancelled after stall. You own finish.

CAPACITY_CARD: pick=cursor (codex deficit; agy cancelled)

## Known root causes (tool-backed)

### #6611 react bump
CI Frontend log (job 94029233876):
```
Incompatible React versions: The "react" and "react-dom" packages must have the exact same version.
  - react:      19.2.8
  - react-dom:  19.2.7
```
Dependabot only bumped react, not react-dom.

AGY already committed a fix on branch **`cursor/dependabot-frontend-fix`** (push from worktree):
- commit `29857166cf` — bump react-dom to 19.2.8 alongside react 19.2.8 + @types/react 19.2.18
- also minor PYTHON env in npm scripts + tiny unit test tweaks

### #6607 astro group
CI Frontend log showed `ECONNREFUSED :3000` during Frontend (build+vitest) — separate from react mismatch. Fix or prove flake after #6611 is green.

## Required work
1. `git fetch origin` and work from **`cursor/dependabot-frontend-fix`** (or rebase onto latest origin/main).
2. Local proof in worktree:
   ```bash
   cd site && npm ci
   npm run build   # or the same script CI uses
   npm test        # vitest unit
   ```
   Use primary `.venv` for any python hydrate steps.
3. Open PR for the react fix with body:
   - Fixes the version mismatch for #6611
   - `Closes #6611` only if it fully supersedes dependabot PR; otherwise say "supersedes dependabot #6611" and close #6611 with `gh pr close 6611 --comment ...` after your PR merges, OR request dependabot merge after green if prefer stacking.
   Prefer **one clean PR that replaces #6611** (close dependabot PR with pointer).
4. Then #6607: either fix astro bump (recreate/rebase, fix real break) or document block with CI evidence. Open separate PR if needed.
5. Arm auto-merge after green CI Gate (you may not merge yourself without CF if policy requires — at least open PR + local proof; orchestrator will CF).

## #6611 — react/react-dom mismatch

**PR:** https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6659

- Aligns `react-dom@19.2.8` with `react@19.2.8` and `@types/react@19.2.18`
- Adds `${PYTHON:-.venv/bin/python}` for dispatch worktrees
- **Local proof:** build + 996 tests passed
- **Auto-merge:** armed (squash)
- **Dependabot #6611:** closed with pointer to #6659

## #6607 — astro group + preview adapter pin

**PR:** https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6660

**Root cause:** Dependabot bumped `astro` but left `supportedAstroVersion` at `7.1.3`. The raw-atlas preview adapter requires an exact match, so `startPreview` throws before binding a port → vitest shows `ECONNREFUSED :3000`.

**Fix:**
- Bump astro group deps (lockfile resolves to Astro 7.2.1)
- Update `supportedAstroVersion` → `7.2.1`
- Fix `allowScripts` for `better-sqlite3@13.0.2` (needed for `npm ci`)

- **Local proof:** build + 996 tests passed (including `raw-atlas-shard-transport.test.ts`)
- **Auto-merge:** armed (squash)
- **Dependabot #6607:** commented with supersede pointer (close after merge)

## Cleanup

Removed `site/node_modules` and `site/dist` to free disk.

## Residual

CI Gate is still running on both PRs. Orchestrator can merge once green — auto-merge is set on both. Close Dependabot #6607 after #6660 merges.
